verdict.rationale: Rootly documents two-way Slack and Microsoft Teams integration: responders can declare, run, and resolve incidents from either, and acknowledge, escalate, and resolve on-call pages directly in Teams. It also documents Jira workflow actions for filing tickets, plus a read-only AI connector that looks up related Jira issues. Zoom and GitHub are never named; only a generic Meeting Scribe that joins bridges and generic 'code' connectors appear. Missing for 10: evidence of two-way Jira state sync, a named Zoom integration, a named GitHub integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
